findings.detail: authorizeAttachment awaits its separate approval actor after Native write ACL, lease, and mounted/mutation checks. Consume the one-shot operation before the final authority/cancellation fences, retaining the last mounted/write eligibility check at the dispatch boundary.

mayHaveSavedIntent begins false. If another presentation saves a pending intent after recovery load, the later claim or pending lookup can fail before it becomes true; presentUploadFailure then marks recovery ready without a pending request, enabling Add instead of offering Check. Treat absence conservatively until a held claim has positively observed no pending intent.

Published e96 resume maps journal.lookup nil to noRecordedAttachment. Original AnyProtectedCreationJournal.load creates a new empty namespace when no files exist. The result cannot prove no prior dispatch or the same original physical journal. Cold caller intent must remain unresolved; remove only after verified Host plus actual FilesV2 reconciliation. Picker cancellation before selection remains unchanged.
findings.supersedes: Earlier design approval for noRecorded-only discard was based on incomplete journal-continuity evidence. This correction does not request new user permission or a duplicate journal.
